info.title: Call Coach API
info.description: UTC timestamps. Browser mutations require matching Origin. Opaque cookie sessions expire after 24 hours by default. Bearer keys only list/read/create/update scripts. Invalid graph drafts are saved; schema-invalid writes leave prior state unchanged.

Definition.title: Call Coach script definition
Definition.description: schemaVersion 1. Save graph-invalid drafts with structured errors. Normal calls require exactly one start, all nodes reachable, unique node/option IDs, nonblank text/names/labels, at least two connected switch options, existing targets, no cycles, and no consecutive switches. Text nodes may be terminal and branches may merge. Full replacements remove omitted elements. Layout is optional.
